HOTEL LOUVOIS
SQUARE LOUVOIS
Près l'Opéra
Télégr.: HOTEL LOUVOIS PARIS
Téléph. { RICHELIEU 64-41
(10 Lignes groupées)

Paris, le Lundi

Dear Charlot, I have hard work,
the translation has to be changed
word for word. I shall return
Monday and we will make an
appointement in London as soon
I know the right time. You may
use the time to prepare all for
Wilmot in different schemes so
that we can decide before
seeing him
Paris is marvellous now in the
pages.notes: Briefpapier des Hotel Louvois. Handschriftlicher Text in violetter Tinte.

pages.transcription:
spring, I sit in many cafes here
and do there my work and corres-
pondance. All is so cheap, sorry
that I took so little luggage and
cannot buy anything.
Yours

StefanZweig

Has my diary been sent back
already?
